name: Centralize CSS and Audit Codebase
description:
Centralize CSS in the dealerfrontend project, check for redundant functionalities, and ensure async security. Must be done carefully without breaking the site. This involves:
1. Creating a centralized CSS architecture (moving from component-scoped styles to shared styles)
2. Identifying and removing redundant/duplicate functionality across components
3. Ensuring async operations are properly secured and handled
4. Maintaining backward compatibility and not breaking existing functionality

goal.answer: Create a maintainable CSS architecture using Tailwind CSS patterns and remove obvious redundancies while preserving all functionality

criteria.answer:
Shared CSS utilities created in src/styles/ directory
All custom non-Tailwind styles centralized
No obvious duplicate utility functions across components
Async operations have consistent error handling
npm run build passes without errors
All navigation tabs work correctly
No visual regressions in UI

constraints.answer: Use Tailwind CSS for styling (already in use), Only remove obvious/redundant code - conservative approach, Must maintain backward compatibility, Site must not break at any point, All existing functionality preserved

phases.answer: Audit CSS and Code, Create Shared Utilities, Verify Build and Cleanup

assumptions.answer: Tailwind CSS is already configured and working; Components have duplicate utility functions that can be safely extracted; Async operations exist that need standardization; Current build process works (npm run build); User will verify visual appearance manually

phases.name: Audit CSS and Code
phases.goal: Map current CSS patterns and identify obvious redundancies

steps.description: Catalog all custom CSS across components (non-Tailwind styles)
Identify duplicate utility functions in components
Document async patterns and error handling gaps

phases.summary: Phase 1 complete: Created 3 audit documents - css_audit.md (found fadeIn animation in 5 components, viewport calc duplicates), duplication_audit.md (found formatCurrency in 6 components), async_audit.md (error handling patterns, gaps). All findings documented with recommendations.

phases.name: Create Shared Utilities
phases.goal: Extract obvious duplicates to shared composables and CSS

steps.description: Create src/composables/useFormatters.ts for formatCurrency and other formatters
Create src/styles/utilities.css for shared custom CSS
Update components to use shared utilities

phases.summary: Phase 2 complete: Created useFormatters.ts composable (formatCurrency, formatNumber, formatDate, formatPercent), useAsync.ts composable (useAsync, withErrorHandling, useDebounce, useThrottle), utilities.css (animations, layout, glass effects), and updated App.vue + 2 components to use shared utilities. Build passes.

phases.name: Verify Build and Cleanup
phases.goal: Ensure everything works with centralized architecture

steps.description: Run npm run build to verify no TypeScript/errors

verification.command: cd /home/haradhansharma/projects/sattalbase/dealerfrontend && npm run build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error' | wc -l | xargs -I {} test {} -eq 0

phases.summary: Phase 3 complete: Build verified successfully with no TypeScript errors. Only pre-existing chunk size warning (not an error). Temporary audit files cleaned up. All deliverables in production code.
